destinations.heading: Our destinations.
destinations.lead: Every home we have in each country, on one page.

spain.label: Spain
spain.desc: Spain combines world-class beaches, vibrant culture and year-round sunshine across Mallorca, Ibiza, the Costa del Sol and beyond — all at remarkable value for discerning co-owners.

france.label: France
france.desc: From the sun-drenched shores of the Côte d'Azur to the ski slopes of the French Alps and the timeless elegance of Paris, France is Europe's most coveted address for fractional ownership.

usa.label: USA
usa.desc: From the surf culture of California to the ski slopes of Colorado and the waterfront glamour of Florida, America's luxury property market offers extraordinary opportunities for international co-owners.

italy.label: Italy
italy.desc: Italy's extraordinary landscapes — from the glassy waters of Lake Como to the ancient villages of Liguria and the Tuscan hills — make it a perennial favourite for discerning co-owners.

portugal.label: Portugal
portugal.desc: From the golden coastline of the Algarve to the elegant boulevards of Lisbon and the unspoilt beauty of the Silver Coast, Portugal is one of Europe's most exciting destinations for luxury co-ownership.

austria.label: Austria
austria.desc: Austria's Alpine splendour — from the world-class ski resorts of Tyrol to the grand imperial charm of Vienna — makes it one of Europe's most rewarding destinations for luxury fractional ownership.

england.label: England
england.desc: London remains one of the world's great cities for luxury property — from Mayfair townhouses to riverside apartments — while the English countryside offers idyllic retreats for discerning co-owners.

sweden.label: Sweden
sweden.desc: Sweden's dramatic landscapes — from the Stockholm archipelago to the forested lake districts of the north — offer a uniquely peaceful setting for luxury co-ownership away from the crowds.

germany.label: Germany
germany.desc: From the Bavarian Alps and the shores of Lake Constance to the cultural capitals of Berlin and Munich, Germany offers a compelling range of luxury property opportunities for co-owners.

croatia.label: Croatia
croatia.desc: Croatia's breathtaking Adriatic coastline, crystal-clear waters and historic walled towns like Dubrovnik make it one of the Mediterranean's most coveted destinations for luxury fractional ownership.

mexico.label: Mexico
mexico.desc: From the turquoise shores of the Riviera Maya to the Pacific glamour of Los Cabos, Mexico offers extraordinary luxury at exceptional value — making it one of the most exciting co-ownership markets in the world.

values.heading: The difference is in the details.

items.p: A deeded share of the home itself, registered in your name. Not a timeshare, not a membership — you can sell it, pass it on, and gain if it rises in value.
Around six weeks a year with a one-eighth share, scheduled so everyone gets the peak dates over time. Book ahead in the owners’ app; stay longer when weeks go unused.
Professionally managed and maintained, with the running costs shared. You arrive to a ready home and leave the rest to the team.
Before you commit, you get the facts for the home you are looking at — the weeks, the running costs, how resale works — in plain language, from a person.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions.

items.q: What is co-ownership of a holiday home?
items.a: You and a small number of other owners each buy a deeded share of a fully managed home — typically one eighth. It is real property ownership, registered in your name, not a timeshare or a membership. You get the home, the furnishings and the management, at a fraction of the cost of buying it alone.

items.q: How is it different from a timeshare?
items.a: A timeshare sells you time; co-ownership sells you the property. Your share is a legal interest in the home itself, so you benefit if it rises in value and you can sell it on the open market when you choose. There is no points system and no lock-in.

Your share of the home, fully furnished and equipped to a turnkey standard. What sits on top varies by country — purchase taxes and notary fees in Spain, for example — and we tell you exactly what applies to any home you ask about, before you commit.

items.q: How much time do I get?
items.a: A one-eighth share gives you around six weeks a year, scheduled so every owner gets peak dates over time. Each home has a booking app where you reserve stays months ahead and pick up unused weeks at short notice. The exact number of nights and the booking rules differ by home, and we set them out for you.

items.q: Can I rent out my weeks?
items.a: It depends on the home. Some homes hold a tourist licence and run a managed rental programme; others are for owners and their guests only. We check the policy for every home before we tell you it can be let.
A professional management team handles maintenance, housekeeping, insurance and repairs, funded by the owners' shared running costs. You arrive to a ready home and leave the rest to them.

items.q: Can I sell my share later?
items.a: Yes. After an initial holding period — usually twelve months — you can sell at a price you set. Your co-owners typically get first refusal, then it goes to the open market. We can help you find a buyer.

Across Europe and the United States: the Alps, the Balearics and the Costa del Sol, Tuscany and the Italian lakes, Paris, London, Portugal, Austria, Germany, and the American West and Florida. New homes are added every week.
Browse the homes, or tell us where and when you would like to be there. A person replies — usually within a few hours — with real availability, real figures and the questions worth asking.
